## Terms

### Journal compression

- **Journal compression** · self — Journal compression and collection block compression are separate settings: engineConfig.journalCompressor controls journal data, while collectionConfig.blockCompressor controls collection blocks. Treating collection compression results as journal-specific savings would conflate these settings. (hig — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/configuration-options/
